meta.name: geniml
meta.description: This skill should be used when working with genomic interval data (BED files) for machine learning tasks. Use for training region embeddings (Region2Vec, BEDspace), single-cell ATAC-seq analysis (scEmbed), building consensus peaks (universes), or any ML-based analysis of genomic regions. Applies to BED file collections, scATAC-seq data, chromatin accessibility datasets, and region-based genomic feature learning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你处理基因组区间数据（BED 文件），训练区域嵌入（Region2Vec、BEDspace）、单细胞 ATAC-seq 分析（scEmbed）、构建共识峰（universe）等机器学习任务。
howto.when: 当你需要分析 BED 文件集合、单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据或染色质可及性数据集，进行基于区域的基因组特征学习时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Region2Vec 训练这些 BED 文件的区域嵌入。
用 scEmbed 分析这个单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据并聚类。
say.note: 会执行 scEmbed 训练和 scanpy 聚类。

say.text: 从这些 BED 文件构建一个共识峰集（universe）。
say.note: 会运行 universe build 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you process genomic interval data (BED files) for machine learning tasks, including training region embeddings (Region2Vec, BEDspace), single-cell ATAC-seq analysis (scEmbed), and building consensus peaks (universes).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze BED file collections, single-cell ATAC-seq data, or chromatin accessibility datasets for region-based genomic feature learning.

say_en.text: Train region embeddings for these BED files using Region2Vec.
say_en.note: Will invoke tokenization and region2vec pipeline.

say_en.text: Analyze this single-cell ATAC-seq data with scEmbed and cluster cells.
say_en.note: Will run scEmbed training and scanpy clustering.

say_en.text: Build a consensus peak set (universe) from these BED files.
